situationTags.fil: Hindi ako binabayaran ng minimum wage
situationTags.en: I am not being paid the minimum wage

situationTags.fil: Gusto kong malaman ang minimum wage sa aking rehiyon
situationTags.en: I want to know the minimum wage in my region

right.fil: Ang bawat empleyado sa private sector ay may karapatang makatanggap ng kahit minimum na sahod na itinakda ng Regional Tripartite Wages and Productivity Board (RTWPB) para sa kanilang rehiyon.
right.en: Every private sector employee has the right to receive at least the minimum wage set by the Regional Tripartite Wages and Productivity Board (RTWPB) for their region.

whatThisMeans.fil: Ang minimum wage ay nagbabago ayon sa rehiyon — ang NCR ay may mas mataas kaysa sa ibang probinsya. Ang RTWPB ng bawat rehiyon ang nagtatakda nito. Hindi maaaring bayaran ang empleyado nang mas mababa sa minimum wage — kahit anong kasunduan ang gawin ng employer at empleyado. Para sa pinakabagong rate sa iyong rehiyon, bisitahin ang DOLE o NWPC website.
whatThisMeans.en: Minimum wage varies by region — NCR has higher rates than provinces. Each region's RTWPB sets the rate. An employee cannot be paid below the minimum wage — regardless of any agreement between employer and employee. For the latest rate in your region, visit the DOLE or NWPC website.

theyCannot.fil: Bayaran ka nang mas mababa sa minimum wage ng iyong rehiyon.
theyCannot.en: Pay you below your region's minimum wage.

theyCannot.fil: Gawing 'allowance' o 'tip' ang bahagi ng minimum wage para mabawasan ang base pay.
theyCannot.en: Count allowances or tips as part of the minimum wage to reduce your base pay.

theyCannot.fil: Gumawa ng kasunduan na mas mababa sa minimum wage — ang ganitong kasunduan ay walang bisa.
theyCannot.en: Make an agreement for wages below the minimum — such agreements are void.

youCan.fil: Tingnan ang pinakabagong minimum wage order para sa iyong rehiyon sa NWPC website: nwpc.dole.gov.ph
youCan.en: Check the latest minimum wage order for your region at the NWPC website: nwpc.dole.gov.ph

youCan.fil: Mag-file ng reklamo sa DOLE Regional Office kung hindi ka binabayaran ng minimum.
youCan.en: File a complaint with the DOLE Regional Office if you are not paid the minimum.

youCan.fil: Humingi ng tulong sa DOLE hotline: 1349.
youCan.en: Seek help from the DOLE hotline: 1349.

eli5.fil: May pinakamababang sahod na dapat ibayad sa iyo bawat araw. Ito ay nag-iiba depende sa saan ka nakatira. Kung babayaran ka ng mas mababa niyan, may karapatan kang magreklamo sa DOLE.
eli5.en: There is a minimum daily pay that you must receive. This varies depending on where you live. If paid less than that, you have the right to file a complaint with DOLE.

scopeNotes.fil: MAHALAGA: Ang minimum wage ay regular na binabago ng RTWPB. Ang rate na ito ay maaaring lumuma. Palaging i-verify ang pinakabagong rate sa DOLE o NWPC bago gumawa ng aksyon. Ang mga kasambahay ay may hiwalay na minimum wage sa ilalim ng Kasambahay Law.
scopeNotes.en: IMPORTANT: Minimum wage is regularly updated by the RTWPB. Any specific rate here may be outdated. Always verify the current rate with DOLE or NWPC before taking action. Household workers have a separate minimum wage under the Kasambahay Law.

citations.quotedText: It is hereby declared the policy of the State to rationalize the fixing of minimum wages and to promote productivity-improvement and gain-sharing measures to ensure a decent standard of living for the workers and their families; to guarantee the rights of labor to its just share in the fruits of production; to enhance employment generation in the countryside through industry dispersal; and to allow business and industry reasonable returns on investment, expansion and growth.
